visual_review: Before read as letters (zigzag mesa over two brackets with a squiggle). Redrawn: stepped canyon walls (terraces 10 apart, risers 8 apart) descending to a gorge with the river winding along its floor; the far rim sits lower with the sun above it. Valid, gate pass.
omissions: Distant mesa silhouette and the reference's wide river banks (a canyon at 48 reads through its terraces; the gorge is 12 wide).
